source_backtest_class: SB0_NO_BACKTEST (internal research/shadow design; the PR itself reports no prior backtest claim -- this mission's DEV replay is the first evidence of any kind)

G1_CONTRACTABLE.reason: Exact entry/stop/target geometry, exact decision timestamp (M15 candle close), closed-bar semantics, deterministic A->B->C priority.

G2_TICKETABLE.reason: Discrete entry (MARKET or LIMIT), fixed initial SL, two-leg target structure (75% @ 4R / 25% @ 5R acts as TP1/TP2), at most one qualifying setup per symbol/cycle by construction, M15 decision window (>=5 minutes).

G3_DATA_VENUE_FIT.GBPUSD: HOLD_DATA (only ~6-week DEV window physically present; insufficient for a 2-cycle min_trade_count=30 DEV screen)
G3_DATA_VENUE_FIT.USDJPY: HOLD_DATA (no OHLC history present in this checkout)
G3_DATA_VENUE_FIT.XAUUSD: HOLD_DATA (no OHLC history present in this checkout)

G4_CAUSALITY_WARMUP.causality_reason: Reference window strictly precedes trade window; evaluate() scans trade_candles in chronological order and returns on the first qualifying candle, never inspecting later candles to decide on an earlier one.
G4_CAUSALITY_WARMUP.warmup_invariance: PASS (trivial/by construction: each day's decision depends only on that day's own reference+trade candle set, with zero cross-day state; there is no warm-up window to vary).

G5_TRANSLATION_FIDELITY.reason: This mission's internal_reference copy is byte-identical to PR #33's own source; no translation performed.

ag_reproduced_basis: Deterministic execution of the byte-identical PR #33 engine against a hashed, declared DEV dataset partition; run identity recorded in dev_replay/INT_C001_SESSION_TRADE_V2__EURUSD__{LONDON_NEWYORK,ASIAN_LONDON}__TRAIN/run_manifest.json.
friction_result: FAIL under both BASE and STRESS spread scenarios (net expectancy more negative than gross in both cycles). Commission UNKNOWN throughout -- not set to zero; true net result is likely worse, not better.
verdict_reason: DEV replay of the actual PR #33 engine against real EURUSD M15 data over 9 months (TRAIN partition) shows a decisively negative gross expectancy in BOTH supported sessions (-0.25R LONDON_NEWYORK, -0.14R ASIAN_LONDON), well below the preregistered kill thresholds, before any friction is even applied. This is DEV-stage evidence only (not EDGE_VERIFIED, not a claim about the owner's discretionary interpretation of the underlying price-action idea) but is sufficient under the preregistered policy to reject this specific deterministic formalization for a freeze campaign without further replay spend.
